entry.author: New Zealand Story
entry.summary:
This video introduces the Māori Partnership Story - showcasing the bold, innovative and values‑driven approach of Māori enterprise in Aotearoa New Zealand.

It highlights how pakihi Māori (Māori businesses) draw on deep connections to people, place, and ancestral legacy, creating a distinctive way of doing business that resonates locally and globally.
Hear from Māori business leaders as they share how they engage with partners around the world and create long‑term value through relationships, innovation, and cultural strength.
